title: 第542章 祖灵氏族英灵第541章 炖肉与冷餐会
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
第542章祖灵·氏族英灵
苍莽的号角长音里，仿佛有一头巨鹿在长鸣。
低沉而悠远。
长鸣之中，你还能听出一些狼群的低嚎。
彼此重叠，像是从远处的山谷一路逼近圣城。
同时还伴随着猎鹰尖啸。
锐利的鸣叫撕开长音，从所有人头顶一掠而过。
更多声音紧跟着涌来。
野兽奔跑时粗重的喘息。
利爪刨开泥土，蹄足踩碎冰层。
仿佛有成百上千头野兽正在荒原上同时发起奔跑。
蹄爪践踏大地的震动，从号角声里变成了真实。
“咚！咚！咚！……”
第四层台地的长桌轻轻一颤。
杯中清水泛起大片波纹。
第三层巡礼广场上，刚刚分发下去的肉汤也在木碗里一圈圈晃动。
几块炖肉撞在碗边，发出轻响。
花岗岩台地下方，传来沉闷震动。
像是真有一支看不见的兽群，正沿着圣·佩德罗城的悬崖向上狂奔。
奥林是最先反应过来的人。

号角里刚刚出现巨鹿长鸣，他脸上的平静便消失了。
这位木精灵德鲁伊猛地抬起头。
双眼睁大。
瞳孔在极短时间内收缩成一点。
他手里还握着一只木杯。
五根手指一点点收紧。
坚硬杯壁发出轻微的“咔”声，杯沿随之出现一条浅白色压痕。
再用一点力气，整只杯子恐怕都会被他当场捏碎。
号角没有给任何人询问的时间。
“呜嗡——！”
兽群奔腾的声音再次穿过七层台地。
这一次。
整座圣城各处，同时发生了变化。
一层台地的一处货运通道旁，一名正在协助维持秩序的教会修士突然停下脚步。
二层的餐厅外，负责核验食品清单的圣职者僵在原地。
三层巡礼广场上，一名刚刚替孩子盛完肉汤的牧师松开了汤勺。
第四层、第五层、第六层。
相同的情况接连出现。
近百名原本分散在各级台地上的圣职者，同时抬起头。
他们的身体没有立刻移动。

身后却有一团团灰白色雾气缓缓升起。
雾气沿着他们的脊背向上攀升，拉出一道比常人高大得多的轮廓。
content_en:
Chapter 542 Ancestral Spirit·Clan Heroic Spirit
In the long sound of the vast horn, there seems to be a giant deer roaring.
Low and distant.
Among the long calls, you can also hear the low howls of some wolves.
Overlapping each other, they seem to be approaching the Holy City from a distant valley.
Also accompanied by the scream of a falcon.
The sharp cry ripped through the long sound and passed over everyone's heads.
More voices followed.
The beast panted heavily as it ran.
The sharp claws dig through the soil, and the hooves crush the ice.
It seemed as if hundreds of beasts were running across the wasteland at the same time.
The vibration of the hooves trampling the earth became reality from the sound of the horn.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!..."
The long table on the fourth floor trembled slightly.
Large ripples appeared in the clear water in the cup.
In the parade square on the third floor, the broth that had just been distributed was also swaying in circles in the wooden bowl.
A few pieces of stew clinked against the edge of the bowl.
There was a dull vibration beneath the granite platform.
It was as if there were an invisible herd running wildly up the cliffs of San Pedro.
Orin was the first to react.
The calmness on his face disappeared as soon as the giant deer roared from the horn.
The wood elf druid raised his head sharply.
Eyes wide open.
The pupils shrank to a point in a very short time.
He also held a wooden cup in his hand.
The five fingers tightened little by little.
The hard wall of the cup made a slight "click" sound, and a light white indentation appeared on the edge of the cup.
If he used a little more force, the whole cup would probably be crushed by him on the spot.
The horn gave no one time to ask.
"Woo buzz——!"
The sound of the galloping beasts once again passed through the seven-story platform.
This time.
Changes occurred all over the holy city at the same time.
Next to a freight passage on the first floor, a church monk who was helping to maintain order suddenly stopped.
Outside the restaurant on the second floor, the priest responsible for verifying the food list froze in place.
On the third floor of the parade square, a priest who had just finished serving broth for a child released his spoon.
The fourth floor, the fifth floor, the sixth floor.
The same thing happened one after another.
Nearly a hundred priests who were originally scattered on the platforms at all levels raised their heads at the same time.
Their bodies didn't move immediately.
Behind him, there were masses of gray-white mist rising slowly.
The mist climbed up along their backs, creating a silhouette that was much taller than ordinary people.
